_comment: See game/godot/Audio/SPEC.md for the human-readable workflow. Each entry is a SLOT (the semantic concept, e.g. 'ui_click'). Inside the slot, 'approved' holds the single variant that ships; 'variants' is the review queue of freshly generated alternatives that the human can listen to, approve or deprecate.

globalMusicAnchor.instruments: warm analog synth pads, electric piano (Rhodes), pizzicato strings, soft brushed snare, no drums on menu tracks
globalMusicAnchor.palette: warm 1990s synthwave — muted oranges, deep blues, soft creams. No bright leads, no distorted guitars.
transitionRules: Every track MUST begin and end on the C major tonic chord (C-E-G) so any two tracks can be crossfaded without harmonic clash.
Every track MUST contain a 4-bar bridge at the loop point whose chord progression resolves back to C major, enabling seamless A→B or B→A transitions.
No track introduces chromatic notes, modulations outside the C major scale, or borrowed chords.
No track uses percussion beyond a soft brushed snare — drums belong only to the matchday stingers, which are short non-looping accents.
Every music track MUST use the shared 4-note ascending motif (C-E-G-A or its transpositions) so any two tracks can crossfade without seam.
Every track MUST loop seamlessly: same energy at bar 64 as bar 1, no final cadence, no fade in/out, forward-motion bass into bar 1.
Every music track MUST use the shared 4-note ascending motif (C-E-G-A or its transpositions) so any two tracks can crossfade without seam.
Every track MUST loop seamlessly: same energy at bar 64 as bar 1, no final cadence, no fade in/out, forward-motion bass into bar 1.

entries.prompt: Title screen theme for a retro Spanish football management PC game. Retro late-1990s to early-2000s European PC game music, synth funk, light acid jazz, FM synth era. Warm, slightly nostalgic, optimistic but never saccharine. Designed for seamless looping in a Spanish football management PC game (year 2000 aesthetic, PC Fútbol lineage without copying specific tracks). No vocals. Crisp digital mix, low-fi but punchy. Suitable for long listening sessions (10+ minutes) without listener fatigue. The track must loop seamlessly: same energy and instrumentation at start and end, no fade in/out, no final cadence, no climactic ending. Bass note at bar 64 must create forward motion into bar 1. Subtle variation every 8-16 bars to mask repetition. Memorable 4-6 note motif. Approximately 30 seconds. 114 BPM. shared 4-note ascending motif (C-E-G-A), with restrained variations. Extremely memorable 4-to-6-note melodic hook during the first 5 seconds. The feeling of starting a new season, choosing a club and spending the night managing transfers, tactics and league tables on a PC around the year 2000. Catchy, charming and unmistakably menu music. Avoid: vocals, cinematic orchestra, epic trailer music, trap drums, EDM drops, aggressive bass, dark ambient, flamenco clichés, modern club production.

groups.styleAnchor: Retro 1990s PC speaker UI sound. Short, crisp, synthesized, dry. Should sound like they all came from the same sound chip.

entries.prompt: soft UI click — short and dry, like a finger tapping a membrane keyboard
subtle hover tick — even shorter than the click, almost subliminal
positive confirmation — a short two-note ascending chirp
negative cancel — a short two-note descending chirp
error buzz — short buzzy reject tone
incoming notification — soft bell-like ping, ~250ms

groups.styleAnchor: Retro 1990s football management PC game stadium sound effects. Should sound lo-fi but unmistakable — they are what the manager hears from the stands.

entries.prompt: referee short whistle — single sharp blast, ~600ms
referee long whistle — sustained blast, ~1.5 seconds
penalty award whistle — three short sharp blasts in quick succession
stadium crowd short cheer — quick roar that decays in ~2 seconds
stadium crowd disappointed groan — short communal 'ohhh', ~1.5 seconds
stadium crowd rhythmic clapping chant — repeated claps with low vocal roar, ~3 seconds
football kick impact — leather thud with a touch of boot-on-ball squeak
football bouncing on grass — two quick soft bounces
ball hitting the goalpost — sharp metallic clang
